summary: The diff implements most requirements with good coverage of the home page transformation, category navigation, product grid, user dashboard, theme switcher, and responsive design. However, some specific styling requirements lack clear evidence, and the hero banner implementation may not fully match the specification. Authentication requirements appear partially implemented through existing hooks. Product image generation is not verified from the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Logo uses elegant gold color (#D4AF37 or antique gold from theme) on dark background
missing_requirements.reason: The HomeSection.tsx shows a logo image with drop-shadow filter but does not demonstrate gold font color or text-based logo implementation as specified

missing_requirements.requirement: Add a user profile/dashboard icon in the top right corner of the navigation bar
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence in the diff of a profile icon being added to the navigation bar or header component
Diff mentions 28px rounded corners in ProductCard summary, not the specified 16px

missing_requirements.requirement: Hero banner with full-width saree showcase image
missing_requirements.reason: HeroBanner.tsx shows fixed height (400px/500px) with rounded corners (rounded-2xl), not full-width spanning implementation

missing_requirements.requirement: Save button updates user profile data in the backend
missing_requirements.reason: DashboardPage shows saveProfile call but backend main.mo diff is truncated, cannot verify complete backend implementation of profile update

missing_requirements.requirement: Generate five product images showing sarees on models with dimensions 800x1000 pixels
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence of actual image file generation or placement in frontend/public/assets/generated directory in the diff

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module for user profile schema changes with address field addition
hallucinated_features.reason: backend/migration.mo adds address migration logic not requested in BuildRequest; the requirement only asks to display and update profile data, not migrate schemas

hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-23 requests three theme options with localStorage persistence, but ThemeSwitcher.tsx implements Card/CardHeader/CardContent components with extensive styling not specified

hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in BuildRequest; requirements focus on luxury theme and product display, not animated ocean backgrounds
